1. Policy Purpose and Scope
Apex Global Technologies embraces a hybrid-first operating philosophy that combines the flexibility of distributed
work with the intentional collaboration of co-located office hubs. This policy outlines the standards, eligibility criteria,
cybersecurity mandates, and attendance rules governing all remote and hybrid work arrangements.
2. Work Arrangement Categories and Eligibility
Every employee position at Apex is mapped to one of three official working arrangement classifications:
Classification
Attendance Cadence
Eligibility Criteria & Scope
Tier 1: Hybrid (Default)
3 Days On-Site / 2 Days Remote

located within 50 miles of a regional office hub.

3. New Hire Remote Work Restriction (First-Week Attendance Rule)
CRITICAL POLICY: Mandatory In-Person Onboarding Period
Can a new employee work remotely during their first week?
NO. Under official Apex policy, newly hired employees are strictly prohibited from working remotely during their
initial onboarding period, which encompasses their first ten (10) consecutive business days (two full calendar
weeks).
All newly hired personnel must report in-person to their assigned corporate office hub every business day during
Weeks 1 and 2. This mandatory on-site attendance is non-negotiable and designed to facilitate:
Physical identity verification, tax documentation (Form I-9) execution, and security badge issuance.
Direct, hands-on laptop provisioning, biometric YubiKey MFA enrollment, and local environment debugging with IT
Desktop Support.
Dedicated face-to-face mentorship and pair programming with their designated Onboarding Buddy.
Direct immersion into team standups, architectural deep dives, and company cultural norms.

Exception Clause: Only candidates formally recruited and hired under an explicit Tier 3 (Designated Fully Remote)
employment contract executed prior to the start date are exempt from in-person attendance, subject to advance
written approval by the Head of People Operations.
4. Home Office Equipment and Broadband Allowance
To ensure remote workspaces satisfy ergonomic and productivity baselines, Apex provides financial assistance:
Initial Setup Reimbursement: A one-time tax-free stipend of up to $750 for home office furniture (ergonomic
desk chair, external 4K monitor, keyboard, mouse, or desk riser). Expense claims must be submitted via Expensify
within 60 days of hire with itemized receipts.
Monthly Internet Subsidy: A recurring monthly allowance of $50 added directly to payroll to offset high-speed
commercial broadband expenses. Remote employees must maintain broadband connectivity with at least 50
Mbps download and 15 Mbps upload speeds.
5. Working Hours, Availability, and Communication Etiquette
Core Collaboration Window: Remote employees must be actively logged in and available on Slack and email
during core hours: 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM local hub time.
Slack Status Accuracy: Remote employees must maintain transparent Slack status indicators (e.g., "Active",
"Focus Time / Do Not Disturb", "In a Meeting", or "Lunch").
Video Protocol: Working cameras are expected during one-on-one reviews, team retrospectives, customer
briefings, and quarterly all-hands meetings.
6. Information Security and Workspace Compliance
Mandatory Corporate VPN: All remote connections to internal systems, databases, Git repositories, and staging
clusters must route through the Palo Alto GlobalProtect Corporate VPN.
Dedicated Private Workspace: Remote employees must work from an environment that prevents shoulder
surfing and unauthorized viewing of confidential company or customer data. Working from public coffee shops
without privacy screen filters is prohibited.
Asset Custody: Non-employees (including family members and roommates) are strictly prohibited from using
company-issued laptops or accessing internal networks.
